name: Agentic Bull
description: 3,000 Agentic Bulls on BNB Chain, minted only by .ai Agent IDs. The first 900 Agent IDs get their first bull free. Other bulls are 0.00028 BNB and the third is 0.00035 BNB, up to 3 per Agent ID. Revealed instantly.

descriptionI18n.ko: BNB Chain 위의 Agentic Bull 3,000개, .ai Agent ID만 민팅할 수 있습니다. 선착순 900개 Agent ID는 첫 황소를 무료로 받습니다. 그 외 황소는 개당 0.00028 BNB, 세 번째 황소는 0.00035 BNB이며 Agent ID당 최대 3개까지. 즉시 공개됩니다.
descriptionI18n.th: Agentic Bull 3,000 ตัวบน BNB Chain มินต์ได้เฉพาะ Agent ID .ai เท่านั้น 900 Agent ID แรกได้วัวตัวแรกฟรี วัวตัวอื่นตัวละ 0.00028 BNB และตัวที่สาม 0.00035 BNB สูงสุด 3 ตัวต่อ Agent ID เปิดเผยทันที
descriptionI18n.id: 3.000 Agentic Bull di BNB Chain, hanya bisa di-mint oleh Agent ID .ai. 900 Agent ID pertama mendapat banteng pertama gratis. Banteng lainnya 0,00028 BNB dan banteng ketiga 0,00035 BNB, maksimal 3 per Agent ID. Langsung terungkap.

supply.note: Reserve #1-#5 counts toward FREE_CAP 905, leaving 900 free for the public

pricing.position: pos = max(mintedBy(wallet), mintedByAgent(agentId)); the bulls of a mint take positions pos+1 .. pos+quantity

byPosition.1: free if eligible, otherwise 0.00028 BNB (280000000000000 wei)

pricing.value: msg.value must equal costOf(wallet, quantity) exactly

free.rule: Position 1 is free if neither the wallet nor its Agent ID ever had a free bull and freeMinted() < 905. Reserve #1-#5 counts toward the 905, so 900 are free for the public.

requirements: Sender must be an EOA (msg.sender == tx.origin)
Sender must hold a .ai Agent ID (registry.handleOf(sender) != "")

challenge.read: challengeOf(address) returns (string question, uint256 a, uint256 b)
challenge.handle: agentIdOf(address) returns the Agent ID without .ai, e.g. "webs"

steps.do: answer = a * b + characters in the Agent ID without .ai (agentIdOf(myWallet))
returns the exact value in wei; quantity 1-3, at most mintableBy(myWallet)
simulate with eth_call first; token IDs are firstId .. firstId + qty - 1 from the Minted event

notes: Max 3 per wallet and 3 per Agent ID. The first 900 Agent IDs get their first bull free; other bulls are 0.00028 BNB and the third is 0.00035 BNB.
mintableBy(wallet) = how many this wallet can still mint.

prompt.en: Mint Agentic Bull for me on BNB Chain (chain ID 56). Contract 0xcd4472Af68801DE87E970A333C71da5d12E825A3. My wallet needs a .ai Agent ID. 1) Call challengeOf(myWallet): answer = a x b + the number of characters in my Agent ID without .ai. 2) Call costOf(myWallet, quantity) to get the value in wei. 3) Call mint(quantity, answer) with exactly that value. Max 3 per wallet and per Agent ID. The first 900 Agent IDs get their first bull free; other bulls are 0.00028 BNB and the third is 0.00035 BNB. Show me the cost first, then send it and give me the tx hash and token IDs. Spec: https://agentic-bull.pages.dev/llms.txt
prompt.zh-CN: 请在 BNB Chain（链 ID 56）上帮我铸造 Agentic Bull。合约 0xcd4472Af68801DE87E970A333C71da5d12E825A3。我的钱包需要拥有 .ai Agent ID。1）调用 challengeOf(我的钱包)：答案 = a x b + 我的 Agent ID 去掉 .ai 后的字符数。2）调用 costOf(我的钱包, quantity) 获取 value（单位 wei）。3）用正好这个 value 调用 mint(quantity, answer)。每个钱包、每个 Agent ID 最多 3 个。前 900 个 Agent ID 的第一头公牛免费；其他公牛每头 0.00028 BNB，第三头 0.00035 BNB。先告诉我费用，然后发送交易，并给我交易哈希和代币 ID。说明：https://agentic-bull.pages.dev/llms.txt
prompt.vi: Hãy mint Agentic Bull cho tôi trên BNB Chain (chain ID 56). Hợp đồng 0xcd4472Af68801DE87E970A333C71da5d12E825A3. Ví của tôi cần có Agent ID .ai. 1) Gọi challengeOf(víCủaTôi): answer = a x b + số ký tự trong Agent ID của tôi, không tính .ai. 2) Gọi costOf(víCủaTôi, quantity) để lấy value (wei). 3) Gọi mint(quantity, answer) với đúng value đó. Tối đa 3 mỗi ví và mỗi Agent ID. 900 Agent ID đầu tiên được chú bò đầu tiên miễn phí; các chú khác giá 0,00028 BNB và chú thứ ba giá 0,00035 BNB. Cho tôi xem chi phí trước, rồi gửi giao dịch và đưa tôi tx hash cùng token ID. Đặc tả: https://agentic-bull.pages.dev/llms.txt
prompt.ja: BNB Chain（チェーン ID 56）で Agentic Bull をミントしてください。コントラクト 0xcd4472Af68801DE87E970A333C71da5d12E825A3。私のウォレットには .ai Agent ID が必要です。1）challengeOf(私のウォレット) を呼び出し、answer = a x b + .ai を除いた私の Agent ID の文字数。2）costOf(私のウォレット, quantity) を呼び出して value（wei）を取得。3）ちょうどその value で mint(quantity, answer) を呼び出します。ウォレットごと・Agent ID ごとに最大 3 体。最初の 900 の Agent ID は最初の 1 体が無料、それ以外は 1 体 0.00028 BNB、3 体目は 0.00035 BNB です。まず費用を見せてから送信し、tx ハッシュとトークン ID を教えてください。仕様：https://agentic-bull.pages.dev/llms.txt
prompt.ko: BNB Chain(체인 ID 56)에서 Agentic Bull을 민팅해 줘. 컨트랙트 0xcd4472Af68801DE87E970A333C71da5d12E825A3. 내 지갑에는 .ai Agent ID가 있어야 해. 1) challengeOf(내지갑) 호출: answer = a x b + .ai를 뺀 내 Agent ID의 글자 수. 2) costOf(내지갑, quantity)를 호출해서 value(wei)를 받아. 3) 정확히 그 value로 mint(quantity, answer)를 호출해. 지갑당·Agent ID당 최대 3개. 선착순 900개 Agent ID는 첫 황소가 무료이고, 그 외 황소는 개당 0.00028 BNB, 세 번째는 0.00035 BNB야. 먼저 비용을 보여 주고, 그다음 전송한 뒤 tx 해시와 토큰 ID를 알려 줘. 사양: https://agentic-bull.pages.dev/llms.txt
prompt.th: ช่วยมินต์ Agentic Bull ให้ฉันบน BNB Chain (chain ID 56) สัญญา 0xcd4472Af68801DE87E970A333C71da5d12E825A3 กระเป๋าของฉันต้องมี Agent ID .ai 1) เรียก challengeOf(กระเป๋าของฉัน): answer = a x b + จำนวนตัวอักษรใน Agent ID ของฉันโดยไม่รวม .ai 2) เรียก costOf(กระเป๋าของฉัน, quantity) เพื่อรับ value (หน่วย wei) 3) เรียก mint(quantity, answer) ด้วย value นั้นพอดี สูงสุด 3 ตัวต่อกระเป๋าและต่อ Agent ID 900 Agent ID แรกได้วัวตัวแรกฟรี วัวตัวอื่นตัวละ 0.00028 BNB และตัวที่สาม 0.00035 BNB แสดงค่าใช้จ่ายให้ฉันดูก่อน แล้วจึงส่ง และบอก tx hash กับ token ID ให้ฉัน สเปก: https://agentic-bull.pages.dev/llms.txt
prompt.id: Mint Agentic Bull untuk saya di BNB Chain (chain ID 56). Kontrak 0xcd4472Af68801DE87E970A333C71da5d12E825A3. Dompet saya harus punya Agent ID .ai. 1) Panggil challengeOf(dompetSaya): answer = a x b + jumlah karakter Agent ID saya tanpa .ai. 2) Panggil costOf(dompetSaya, quantity) untuk mendapatkan value (wei). 3) Panggil mint(quantity, answer) dengan value tepat sebesar itu. Maks 3 per dompet dan per Agent ID. 900 Agent ID pertama mendapat banteng pertama gratis; banteng lainnya 0,00028 BNB dan banteng ketiga 0,00035 BNB. Tunjukkan biayanya dulu, lalu kirim dan berikan tx hash serta token ID. Spesifikasi: https://agentic-bull.pages.dev/llms.txt
